messages.snippet: Sarah, Sterling have come in hot on pricing: 200bps/4.50% margin, 1.00% fee (£420k), and Mar-26 leve
messages.subject: Mallory — Sterling's pricing ask (internal)
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Sterling have come in hot on pricing: 200bps/4.50% margin, 1.00% fee (£420k), and Mar-26 leverage at 5.00x. The leverage step is actually fine — the IBR forecast is 4.99x at Mar-26 so 5.00x gives almost no headroom but is deliverable. On pricing I think we land the margin around 185bps and the fee at ~0.85%. The covenant at 5.00x is worth conceding to win the pricing.

Shall I prepare our counter-redline on that basis?

James

messages.subject: RE: Mallory — Sterling's pricing ask (internal)
messages.plaintextBody:
Agreed. Concede the 5.00x March covenant, hold interest cover at 1.75x for March, and counter at 185bps / 0.85% fee. Make clear to Drummond Hale that the equity cheque and the directors' personal commitment to the turnaround justify the lower pricing. Get the counter out to Richard for sign-off first.

Sarah
